entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Grenada.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Granada.
entry.quote: To visit Grenada, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You can visit Grenada without a visa.
entry.es: Se puede visitar Granada sin visa.
entry.quote: You can visit Grenada without a visa.

entry.en: On entry you are allowed to stay for a maximum of 3 months.
entry.es: Al entrar se permite una estancia máxima de 3 meses.
entry.quote: On entry, you’ll be allowed to stay for a maximum period of 3 months.

entry.en: You must get your passport stamped by the border officer or you will be considered an illegal visitor.
entry.es: Debes conseguir que el oficial de frontera selle tu pasaporte; de lo contrario te considerarán visitante ilegal.
entry.quote: Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport. If you do not get a stamp in your passport, you’ll be considered an illegal visitor.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Grenada, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: You need a passport valid for at least six months and a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: Necesitas un pasaporte válido por al menos seis meses y un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: You need a passport valid for at least six months and a return or onward ticket.

safety.en: Most crime in Grenada is non-violent and opportunistic, such as thefts of unattended items or burglaries from villas or cars.
safety.es: La mayor parte del delito en Granada es no violento y oportunista, como robos de objetos sin vigilar o de villas y coches.
safety.quote: Most crime in Grenada is non-violent and opportunistic, such as thefts of unattended items or burglaries from villas or cars.

safety.en: There are occasional violent crimes including armed robbery and sexual assault.
safety.es: Hay delitos violentos ocasionales, incluidos robo a mano armada y agresión sexual.
safety.quote: There are occasional violent crimes including armed robbery and sexual assault.

safety.en: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.
safety.es: Es ilegal que cualquiera, incluidos los niños, vista ropa de camuflaje.
safety.quote: It’s illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.

safety.en: Certain same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Grenada, and public affection could receive unwanted and negative attention.
safety.es: Ciertos actos sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Granada, y las muestras de afecto en público pueden atraer atención negativa.
safety.quote: Certain same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Grenada. Showing affection in public could receive unwanted and negative attention.

safety.en: Carriacou and Petite Martinique still have reduced tourist infrastructure after Hurricane Beryl hit them in July 2024.
safety.es: Carriacou y Petite Martinique aún tienen infraestructura turística reducida tras el huracán Beryl de julio de 2024.
safety.quote: Hurricane Beryl made landfall on the islands of Carriacou and Petite Martinique in July 2024, and there continues to be reduced tourist infrastructure as rebuilding efforts continue.

safety.en: The Caribbean hurricane season normally runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes del Caribe normalmente va de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season in the Caribbean normally runs from June to November.

health.en: The main government hospital can cope with many types of treatment, but serious cases may need emergency evacuation.
health.es: El principal hospital público atiende muchos tratamientos, pero los casos graves pueden requerir evacuación de emergencia.
health.quote: The main government hospital can cope with many types of treatment but serious cases may need emergency evacuation.

health.en: Medical treatment in Grenada can be expensive, so adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds are needed.
health.es: El tratamiento médico en Granada puede ser caro, por lo que hacen falta un seguro de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles.
health.quote: Medical treatment in Grenada can be expensive. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment and repatriation.

health.en: Wikivoyage says the tap water is safe to drink.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que el agua del grifo es segura para beber.
health.quote: Drink plenty of water (the tap water is safe)

health.en: Wikivoyage says mosquitoes are more a nuisance than a danger, as it is rare for them to carry serious diseases such as malaria.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que los mosquitos son más una molestia que un peligro, pues es raro que transmitan enfermedades graves como la malaria.
health.quote: Mosquitoes are more of a nuisance than a danger: it's rare for them to carry serious diseases such as malaria.

health.en: Wikivoyage warns you can burn quickly in Grenada even when it is cloudy and a breeze keeps you cool.
health.es: Wikivoyage advierte que puedes quemarte rápido en Granada incluso con nubes y una brisa que te refresque.
health.quote: Grenada is only 12 degrees north of the equator and you can burn quickly even if it's cloudy and the breeze is keeping you cool.

help.en: Ambulance numbers are 434 for St George's hospital, 724 for Princess Alice hospital in Grenville and 774 for Princess Royal hospital in Carriacou.
help.es: Los números de ambulancia son 434 (hospital de St George's), 724 (Princess Alice, en Grenville) y 774 (Princess Royal, en Carriacou).
help.quote: Ambulance: 434 for St George’s general hospital, 724 for Princess Alice hospital in Grenville, or 774 for Princess Royal hospital in Carriacou.

help.en: The fire and police emergency number is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias de bomberos y policía es el 911.

help.en: FCDO in London can be called 24 hours on 020 7008 5000 if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: El FCDO en Londres atiende las 24 horas al 020 7008 5000 si algo le ha pasado a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.

getting_in.en: Maurice Bishop International Airport (GND) is the principal arrival point, 8 km from the capital on the southwest tip of Grenada.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Maurice Bishop (GND) es el principal punto de llegada, a 8 km de la capital, en el extremo suroeste de Granada.
getting_in.quote: Maurice Bishop International Airport (GND IATA) is on the southwest tip of the main island of Grenada, 8 km from the capital.

getting_in.en: Lauriston Airport (CRU) is a small airstrip on Carriacou.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Lauriston (CRU) es una pequeña pista en Carriacou.
getting_in.quote: Lauriston Airport (CRU IATA) is a small airstrip on the island of Carriacou.

getting_in.en: Cruise ships dock in St George's.
getting_in.es: Los cruceros atracan en St George's.
getting_in.quote: Cruise ships dock in St George's, and October to May there are usually a couple in port

getting_in.en: Foot-passenger ferries run between Grenada, Carriacou and Petite Martinique.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris de pasajeros a pie entre Granada, Carriacou y Petite Martinique.
getting_in.quote: Osprey foot-passenger ferries ply between the islands of Grenada, Carriacou and Petite Martinique.

getting_in.en: A small passenger ferry connects Carriacou and Union Island on Mondays and Fridays.
getting_in.es: Un pequeño ferri de pasajeros conecta Carriacou y Union Island los lunes y viernes.
getting_in.quote: There is a small passenger ferry connecting Carriacou and Union Island on Mondays and Fridays.

getting_in.en: Private vessels must clear immigration and customs at St George's or Prickly Bay on Grenada, or at Hillsborough on Carriacou.
getting_in.es: Las embarcaciones privadas deben pasar migración y aduana en St George's o Prickly Bay (Granada) o en Hillsborough (Carriacou).
getting_in.quote: Private vessels must clear immigration and customs at St George's or Prickly Bay on Grenada island, or at Hillsborough on Carriacou.

getting_around.en: Eight minibus routes fan out from St George's bus terminal, very frequently along Route 1 to Grand Anse and Calliste.
getting_around.es: Ocho rutas de minibús parten de la terminal de St George's, con gran frecuencia en la Ruta 1 a Grand Anse y Calliste.
getting_around.quote: Eight routes fan out from St George's bus terminal next to the cruiser dock, very frequently along Route 1 to Grand Anse and Calliste.

getting_around.en: A water taxi runs between St George's cruiser dock and Grand Anse beach.
getting_around.es: Un taxi acuático une el muelle de cruceros de St George's con la playa de Grand Anse.
getting_around.quote: A water taxi plies between St George's cruiser dock and Grand Anse beach.

getting_around.en: Taxis are not metered and have standard fares for most destinations.
getting_around.es: Los taxis no tienen taxímetro y hay tarifas estándar para la mayoría de destinos.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are not metered. There are standard taxi fares for most destinations.

getting_around.en: To avoid being overcharged, agree the fare in local currency with the driver before setting off.
getting_around.es: Para evitar cobros excesivos, acuerda la tarifa en moneda local con el conductor antes de salir.
getting_around.quote: To avoid being overcharged, agree the fare in local currency with the driver before you set off.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says hiring a cab for the day is for most visitors a much better way to tour the island than self-drive.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage dice que, para la mayoría, contratar un taxi por el día es mucho mejor que conducir uno mismo para recorrer la isla.
getting_around.quote: Hiring a cab for the day is for most visitors a much better way to tour the island than self-drive

getting_around.en: International car rental companies can issue a temporary Grenada driving permit on the spot.
getting_around.es: Las empresas internacionales de alquiler pueden emitir en el acto un permiso de conducir temporal de Granada.
getting_around.quote: Car rentals are available from a few international companies - the advantage of these is that they can issue a temporary Grenada driving permit on the spot, so you can drive straight off.

money.en: The East Caribbean dollar (XCD) is the currency of Grenada and seven other Caribbean countries.
money.es: El dólar del Caribe Oriental (XCD) es la moneda de Granada y de otros siete países caribeños.
money.quote: The East Caribbean dollar, denoted as $ or EC$ (ISO currency code XCD), is the currency of Grenada and seven other Caribbean countries

money.en: The EC dollar is pegged to the US dollar at a fixed rate of US$1 = EC$2.70.
money.es: El dólar del Caribe Oriental está fijado al dólar estadounidense a US$1 = EC$2,70.
money.quote: The EC dollar is pegged to the United States dollar at a fixed exchange rate of US$1 = EC$2.70.

money.en: US dollar bills are universally accepted on Grenada but coins are not.
money.es: Los billetes de dólar estadounidense se aceptan en todas partes en Granada, pero no las monedas.
money.quote: US dollar bills are universally accepted on Grenada but not coins

money.en: It is difficult to exchange EC$ outside the Caribbean and there is no exchange at the airport.
money.es: Es difícil cambiar EC$ fuera del Caribe y no hay casa de cambio en el aeropuerto.
money.quote: It is difficult to exchange EC$ outside the Caribbean and there is no exchange at the airport.

money.en: Small businesses such as taxi drivers seldom take cards.
money.es: Los pequeños negocios, como los taxistas, rara vez aceptan tarjetas.
money.quote: small businesses such as taxi drivers seldom take cards

money.en: Banks in St George's and Grand Anse have exchange desks open Monday to Friday, 8AM to 2PM.
money.es: Los bancos de St George's y Grand Anse tienen ventanillas de cambio abiertas de lunes a viernes, de 8:00 a 14:00.
money.quote: There are several banks in St George's and Grand Anse, with exchange desks open M-F 8AM-2PM.

connectivity.en: As of January 2023, almost everywhere on the three islands has 4G from Flow and Digicel, and 5G had not rolled out.
connectivity.es: En enero de 2023, casi todo en las tres islas tenía 4G de Flow y Digicel, y aún no había 5G.
connectivity.quote: Almost everywhere on the three islands has 4G from Flow and Digicel, with only a few dead spots in the mountains. As of Jan 2023, 5G has not rolled out in Grenada.
